qualification: Shared-host local Debug, frozen executables, old/new then new/old; seven samples per shape. No task-owned build/E2E/cleanup overlap. Other users run native builds on the shared host. Real Parquet, readiness warming and retained OS/persistent caches. No Release, cloud, empty-cache, archive-scale, or full-query memory qualification. Single publication observations do not isolate ingestion CPU.
oracle_coverage: Layout and native delivery complete hits and outer totals match across binaries and both orders, including historical reference. Mixed identity baseline omits the requested source._id; that known correctness defect is separately retained, not equated with refined output. Mixed cases match complete hits excluding only source._id; every refined source._id is independently verified. Delivery independently asserts every returned field, UTF-8, escaped strings, virtual identity, nulls and four exact integer columns above 2^53. The retained record keeps canonical complete-result hashes, totals and every timing sample after verifying full reports; raw-report hashes bind their originals. Shared fixture/query metadata is retained once per family.
